title: no-vulnerable-react-server-components
message: next@16.2.4 bundles a React Server Components runtime affected by a high-severity denial-of-service vulnerability (CVE-2026-23870) patched in Next.js 16.2.6
help: Upgrade Next.js to 16.2.6 (or newer). Next.js bundles its own React Server Components runtime, so bumping Next.js ships the fix. Run `npm install next@16.2.6`. See https://vercel.com/changelog/next-js-may-2026-security-release

title: Array lookup inside a loop

help: Use a `Set` or `Map` when you check for the same items over and over. `Array.includes`/`find` scans the whole list each time
